freeTierSummary.zh-CN: LG AI 研究院的 EXAONE API 平台于 2026-11-09 开放，官方明确「所有 API 当前免费」，未公布总额度或免费截止日期，仅按请求数限流（429 + 速率响应头）。旗舰 K-EXAONE 2.5 为 750B 总参数 / 31B 激活、512K 上下文（输入 + max_tokens ≤ 524,288）、知识截止 2026-01，OpenAI 兼容。限流：QPS 1、每分钟 60、每日 86,400；响应头 x-{second,minute,day}-rate-limit 可查余量。API Key 自签发起 30 天有效、到期需重建，明文仅显示一次。纯文本模型，官方标注仅支持韩语与英语；条款限定非商业用途，需 19 岁以上，输入输出默认可能被用于训练（可在平台选择退出）。条款与限制以官方为准。
freeTierSummary.en: LG AI Research's EXAONE API Platform opened 2026-11-09; the FAQ states all APIs are currently free, with no quota or end date published. K-EXAONE 2.5 is 750B/31B with a 512K context (input + max_tokens <= 524,288), text-only, OpenAI-compatible. Limits: 1/second, 60/minute, 86,400/day via x-{second,minute,day}-rate-limit headers. Keys last 30 days. Terms: non-commercial, 19+.

zh-CN: 打开 https://docs.exaone.ai/en/login 注册 EXAONE ID（邮箱注册，注册时需选择所在国家/地区）
登录后进入 My Profile 的「API key」页面，点击 Create new API Key
创建后立即复制并保存密钥——官方明确密钥只能看到一次，关掉就再也取不回
以 OpenAI 兼容方式调用：Base URL 填 https://api.exaone.ai/v1，模型名填 k-exaone_v2.5，Authorization: Bearer <你的 Key>
注意 Key 自签发起 30 天有效，到期前重新创建并替换；限流为 1 次/秒、60 次/分钟、86,400 次/日
留意官方限制：仅支持韩语/英语、纯文本无多模态，条款限定非商业用途且需 19 岁以上
en: Sign up for an EXAONE ID at https://docs.exaone.ai/en/login (email signup; you pick your country/region during registration)
After signing in, open My Profile > API key and click Create new API Key
Copy the key immediately — the platform states the secret can never be viewed again
Call it OpenAI-compatibly: base URL https://api.exaone.ai/v1, model k-exaone_v2.5, header Authorization: Bearer <key>
Keys expire 30 days after issue, so recreate and swap before that; limits are 1/second, 60/minute and 86,400/day
Mind the official constraints: Korean/English only, text-only (no multimodality), non-commercial use and age 19+
